signals.text: Checkout payment failures rose from 1% to 31% at 14:04 UTC.
Release payments-2.8.4 reached the affected region at 14:02 UTC.
The region still on 2.8.3 stayed at 1% payment failures.

policy.text: Declare SEV2 when checkout failures exceed 10%. Page Payments On-Call. Propose rollback for incident commander approval when the previous release is healthy. Verify payment failures return below 2%.
